icd_linked.llm_icd_reason: Mapped code at rank 1 is E13.10 (other specified diabetes mellitus with ketoacidosis without coma), while the billed primary code is O24.03 (pre-existing type 1 diabetes mellitus, in the puerperium), an obstetric chapter 15 code that takes sequencing priority in the puerperium. Different code chapters and different specificity (obstetric pre-existing type 1 diabetes vs non-obstetric 'other specified' diabetes with ketoacidosis); a coder would not accept E13.10 as equivalent to O24.03. Note rank 2/6 map to E10.9, which is also not equivalent to the obstetric O24.03 code.
